story.title: Company Overview
story.p1: Pure Environment for Renewable Energy is a leading company in the renewable energy sector, specializing in providing innovative and effective solutions in solar energy. The company was founded with the aim of providing clean and sustainable energy solutions that contribute to environmental protection and cost reduction for its clients.
story.p2: Pure Environment for Renewable Energy is one of the subsidiaries of Tal Holding Group, which has great diversity in its sectors, such as agriculture, commerce, and industry. Through this affiliation with the group, the company is committed to providing high-quality solar energy solutions, benefiting from diverse expertise across various sectors to provide innovative solutions that meet the needs of local, regional, and international markets.
story.p3: Pure Environment for Renewable Energy seeks to facilitate the transition to renewable energy and provide effective solutions for clients across various sectors, including homes and large companies. Thanks to our advanced technologies and specialized team, we ensure the delivery of solar energy systems that achieve high efficiency and economic savings in the long term.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about solar energy in Saudi Arabia

items.q: What is the warranty period for solar panels?
items.a: Solar panels come with a performance warranty of up to 25 years and a 10-12 year product warranty. Inverters carry a 5-10 year warranty depending on the manufacturer.

items.q: Is solar energy effective in the hot Saudi summer?
items.a: Yes. The panels we supply are designed to withstand the Kingdom's high temperatures. While heat above 25°C slightly reduces efficiency, the long sunshine hours across Saudi Arabia more than compensate, making it an ideal environment for power generation.

items.q: What is the difference between a grid-tied and a hybrid system?
items.a: A grid-tied system generates power for direct use or sells the surplus to the utility, with no batteries. A hybrid system adds storage batteries to ensure continuity during outages, making it ideal for farms and industrial facilities.

items.q: How long does system installation take?
items.a: Small residential systems (5-15 kW) take one to two days. Medium commercial and agricultural systems (20-100 kW) take 3 to 7 days. Large projects require a detailed schedule.

items.q: Does a solar system need official permits?
items.a: Yes. Grid-connected systems require approval from the Saudi Electricity Company (SEC) and the Electricity & Cogeneration Regulatory Authority (ECRA). Our team handles the full licensing process on your behalf.
A scheme through which the Saudi Electricity Company lets consumers sell the surplus power their solar system produces back to the grid, noticeably reducing the monthly electricity bill.

items.q: Can the system be expanded later?
items.a: Yes. We design systems with future expansion in mind. Panels or batteries can be added later at a lower cost than a full redesign.

items.q: What is a realistic payback period for a system in Saudi Arabia?
items.a: Agricultural and industrial: 6-10 years. Commercial: 7-12 years. Residential: 12-18 years. These are estimates based on current electricity tariffs and installation costs in the Saudi market.
